# powerdns_rectify_zone (Action)

Recomputes DNSSEC ordering and NSEC records for a zone.

Succeeds on an unsigned zone and on one with `api_rectify` already on — neither is refused, contrary to what the name suggests. A `Slave` zone with nothing transferred answers 422 `No SOA known`.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) The zone to act on.
